# Pocket Cloud

> Pocket Cloud is a free web app that plays Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance games in your browser. You bring ROMs you own; saves back up to the cloud so you can continue on any device.

## What it does

- Runs GB, GBC and GBA games in the browser (WebAssembly emulation), on desktop and mobile.
- Backs up battery saves to the cloud by default (under a random anonymous key stored in the browser, or to your account if you sign in with email), with save history you can restore.
- Optionally keeps your own ROM library in your private account so games follow you across devices.
- Link play: trade and battle with a friend over a virtual link cable on GBA games.
- Custom keyboard and touch controls.

## What it does not do

- It ships no games and no ROMs. You load ROM files dumped from cartridges you own.
- By default only save data is uploaded, never the ROM. A ROM is uploaded only if you choose to keep games in your account.
